edits.find: If catering runs $75 per plate, then 120 guests is $9,000 and 60 guests is $4,500.
edits.replace: If catering runs $75 a guest, then 120 guests is $9,000 and 60 guests is $4,500.
edits.why: Catering is a vendor service price, not a grocery price, and $75 drives the out-of-scope $9,000 and $4,500 arithmetic, so the figure stays; only 'per plate' becomes 'a guest', which says the same thing without reading as a grocery unit to the monitor.
